blocks.title_en: The Appropriation of Movables without an Owner
blocks.title_ar: الاستيلاء على منقول ليس له مالك

blocks.text_en: Whoever takes possession of a movable which has no owner, with the intention of its appropriation, acquires the ownership thereof.
blocks.text_ar: من وضع يده على منقولات لا مالك له ينبه تملكه ، ملكه.

blocks.text_en:
A movable is deemed to have no owner when its owner abandons possession of it with the intention of renouncing his ownership thereto.
Animals, other than domestic animals, are deemed to have no owner as long as they are at liberty. If one of such animals, after losing its liberty, regains its freedom, it becomes without an owner if the owner does not seek it immediately or ceases to seek for it. An animal that has become tame and is accustomed to return to the same place becomes again without an owner if it loses this habit.
blocks.text_ar:
( ١ ) يصبح المنقول لا مالك له إذا خلى عنه مالكه بقصد التزول عن ملكيته .
( ٢ ) وتعتبر الحيوانات غير الألفية لا مالك لها مادامت طليقة . وإذا أعتقل حيوان منها ثم أطلق عاد لا مالك له إذا لم يتبعه المالك فورا وإذا كف عن تتبعه . وما روض من الحيوانات وألف الرجوع إلى المكان المخصص له ثم فقد هذه العادة يرجع لا مالك له.

blocks.text_en:
Buried or hidden treasure to which no one can establish ownership belongs to the owner or the bare owner of the property on which it is discovered.
Treasure discovered on wakf property belongs to the founder of the wakf or to his heirs.
blocks.text_ar:

( ٢ ) والكنز الذي يعثر عليه في عين موقوفة يكون ملكا خاصا للواقف ولورثته.

blocks.text_en: Rights of fishing and hunting and rights to things found and to antiquities are governed by special regulations.
blocks.text_ar: الحق في صيد البحر والبر واللقطة والأشياء الأثرية تنظمه لوائح خاصة.

blocks.title_en: The Appropriation of Immovables which have no Owner
blocks.title_ar: الاستيلاء على عقار ليس له مالك

blocks.text_en:
Uncultivated land which has no owner is the property of the State.
The appropriation or the possession of uncultivated land can only be effected with the authority of the State in accordance with the regulations.
If, however, an Egyptian cultivates or plants uncultivated land or builds thereon, he becomes forthwith owner of the cultivated, planted or built on, even without authority of the State, but he loses his ownership by non-user for five consecutive years during the first fifteen years following his acquisition of ownership.
blocks.text_ar:

( ٢ ) ولا يجوز تملك هذه الأراضي أو وضع اليد عليها إلا بترخيص من الدولة وفقا للوائح.
( ٣ ) إلا أنه زرع مصرع أرضا غير مزروعة أو غرسها أو بنى عليها ، تملك في الحال الجزء المزروع أو المغروس أو المبنى ولو بغير ترخيص من الدولة . ولكنه يفقد ملكيته بعدم الاستعمال مدة خمس سنوات خلال الخمس العشرة السنة التالية للتمليك.

blocks.title_en: Acquisition by Inheritance and Winding up of an Estate

blocks.text_en:
The establishment of the heirs or their hereditary shares and of the devolution of the property of the estate on them is governed by Mohammedan Law and by the laws with regard to inheritance and estates.
The following provisions apply to the winding up of an estate.
